description: Land Title Settlement Department - Harakgalegama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha  District - Cad. Map No.510401
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership, parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner identities, and land encumbrances for multiple land parcels in the Katana area. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
